title: Demo brief: reproducible data pipelines
text: This is a synthetic consulting case, not a statement about a real client. A reproducible data pipeline records source timestamps and content hashes. Idempotent imports avoid duplicate records. Validation catches missing identifiers before loading a SQLite database. Separate training and evaluation data to reduce leakage. CI runs unit and integration tests before releasing a container.

title: Demo brief: retrieval and evidence
text: This is a synthetic educational brief. Retrieval augmented generation first retrieves relevant evidence, then asks a language model to answer from that evidence. BM25 is a lexical ranking baseline and does not understand synonyms like an embedding model. Citations should identify the supporting source and fetch time. When the indexed sources do not contain the answer, the system should abstain. Valid citation identifiers do not prove that a generated claim is supported.

title: Demo brief: deployment trade-offs
text: This is a synthetic educational brief. A local prototype can use FastAPI and SQLite to keep deployment simple. Docker packages the runtime and dependencies. Public deployment also needs authentication, quotas, backups and monitoring. Environment variables hold model API keys outside source control. An external LLM receives the retrieved text and the user's question, so confidential documents require an approved data-processing arrangement.
